messages:
tara (Product): Heads-up: BlinkEmbed published a blog claiming sub-15ms 1024-dim embeddings at p95 on commodity infra. Several deals asked "can you match?" link: https://blinkembed.example/blog/ultra-fast-embeds :loud_sound:

nina (Sales): heard this from two prospects this week. If we can't show a clear response, deal conversion risk. Need a one-pager ASAP.

marco (Eng-ML): initial read: tricks are model distillation + quantized kernels + aggressive caching. Could be quality tradeoffs. I'll run a short spike to reproduce latency/quality numbers. ETA 6 working days.

rachel (Research): I'll prepare recall@k and semantic-similarity baselines across 3 corpora once Marco has artifacts. Also capture embedding drift.

jenny (Design): if we do a public comparison doc, UX should show side-by-side tradeoffs (latency, recall, cost) and an interactive demo for customers. I can draft a wireframe in 3 days.

tara (Product): proposed options: 1) Parity: engineer a "fast" mode (quantized + lower-precision) and ship as "tech-preview" if quality acceptable. 2) Positioning: emphasize our "predictable latency at scale" + higher quality SLAs. 3) Hybrid: offer fast-tier for non-critical search + standard tier for higher quality. We need data to pick.

nina (Sales): preference: hybrid messaging. Sales can offer pilot of "fast-tier" to interested prospects if we get spike numbers.

marco (Eng-ML): spike plan: - quantize 1024 model to 8-bit - bench p95/p99 at 50rps and 300rps - compute recall@10 vs baseline. Will share reproducible scripts.

rachel (Research): I'll run datasets: web-search, product-recs, legal Q&A. Aim for initial numbers in 7 working days.

jenny (Design): I'll attach a small comparison one-pager template to reuse for future competitor claims.

ops-bot: scheduled: embed-fast-mode-spike started by marco at 2167890129

tara (Product): decision rule: if recall@10 drop <=4% and latency improvement >2x p95, greenlight fast-tier pilot. Otherwise focus on messaging + batching improvements. Reconvene in 8 working days with data. :mag_right:
